policy: Only the three required resources and directly connected official services supply active scientific information.

datasets.title: LRO WAC Mosaic Global 303ppd v02
datasets.displayResolution: 2048 × 1024 pixels, WMTS matrix 2, 0.17578125 degrees per pixel; source name indicates 303 pixels per degree, not retained at display scale
datasets.projection: Equirectangular; EPSG:104903 as advertised in service capabilities
datasets.frameCaution: Landing-precision compatibility with Horizons MEAN_ME has not been established. Display coordinates are approximate, not surveyed.
datasets.units: RGB display intensity, not terrain elevation
datasets.use: Real globe imagery; illustrative lighting only

datasets.title: LROC NAC observation M1463278603LC
datasets.provider: LROC QuickMap features service / LROC archive
datasets.coverage: Only the polygon in the archived GeoJSON record
datasets.coordinates: Longitude/latitude degrees; product footprint on display sphere, not a precision control network
datasets.resolution: Footprint vertices rounded to 0.01 degree in returned record. Image pixel resolution is not used for hazard assessment.
datasets.use: Observation center catalog entry, acquisition metadata, rendered footprint and original product link
datasets.status: integrated; no numeric terrain data imported

datasets.title: Lunar surface Sun and Earth observer ephemerides
datasets.coordinates: MEAN_ME lunar geodetic, east longitude positive; height km above Horizons reference sphere
datasets.units: degrees, UTC timestamps for supported dates
datasets.resolution: User-selected time interval; samples interpolated linearly for crossings
datasets.retrieval: Recorded individually in each result and original-response cache

referencePoints: Four mathematical reference coordinates plus one QuickMap observation center. None is claimed to be an approved landing site.
unavailable: Solar eclipse screening in derived Sun availability
legacyExcluded: Surface Data Book study site catalog

visualArtwork.earth: Procedural 3D illustration: generated continents, clouds, ocean and atmosphere. Not geographic Earth data.
visualArtwork.sun: Procedural 3D illustration: animated surface noise, limb shading and corona. Not an observation.
visualArtwork.moonLighting: View-relative studio lighting for surface inspection; not mission-time solar illumination.
visualArtwork.positionsAndScale: Compositional, not astronomical scale or ephemeris placement.
